use_cases: Creates frosted glass effects by layering progressive blur masks over content
Adds visual depth and atmosphere to hero sections and backgrounds
Produces smooth opacity gradients with blur for modern UI aesthetics
Enables direction-controlled blur reveals for dramatic visual transitions
Serves as decorative overlay elements in landing pages and dashboards
ai_summary: A React component that generates multiple layered blur masks with gradient-based opacity control, creating a frosted glass or progressive reveal effect. Uses CSS backdrop-filter and mask-image properties to apply increasing blur intensity across configurable directional layers.
